description: This file implements a low-level memory allocator for the Abseil C++ library, including skiplist management for free memory blocks, arena management, and platform-specific memory mapping functions.

classes.name: LowLevelAlloc::Arena
classes.description: Represents a memory arena used by the allocator, managing free blocks and allocation metadata.

methods.name: LowLevelAlloc::Arena
methods.description: Constructor initializing arena parameters based on flags.

methods.name: LowLevelAlloc::NewArena
methods.description: Creates a new memory arena with specified flags.

methods.name: LowLevelAlloc::DeleteArena
methods.description: Deletes a memory arena, freeing all associated memory blocks.

methods.name: LowLevelAlloc::DefaultArena
methods.description: Returns the default global memory arena.
